question: Which of the following is India's longest road tunnel and the first tunnel with a fully integrated tunnel control system?
solution:
The correct answer is **''Chenani-Nashri Tunnel''.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chenani-Nahri Tunnel** is India's longest tunnel and it is also Asia's longest bi-directional highway tunnel.
 
• This tunnel is also known as **Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel.**
 
• Its total length is **9.028 km**. This tunnel reduces the distance between Jammu and Srinagar by 30 km.
 
• This tunnel is the **world's sixth road tunnel** with a transverse ventilation system, this system prevents suffocation. 
 
• This tunnel is named after Syama Prasad Mookerjee, who was the Minister for Industry and Supply in Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru's cabinet.
 
• This tunnel will reduce the distance between Jammu and Srinagar by almost 2 hours and also prevents the danger of landslides.
 
• It is located at an altitude of nearly 4,000 feet.
 
• Fire safety measures are also provided in this tunnel.
 
• 124 cameras are installed for the safety of travelers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pin Panjal Tunnel -** 

 
 
• It is also called as Banihal-Qazigund Railway Tunnel.
 
• This tunnel is located in Jammu and Kashmir, India.
 
• It is India's longest transportation tunnel that is 11.2 Km long.
 
• This tunnel has reduced the distance between Quazigund and Banihal.
 
 
 
• **Sangaldan Tunnel -** 
 
 
• It is a railway tunnel between Katra-Banihal.
 
• The total length of this tunnel is 7.1 km.
 
• This tunnel is constructed by Konkan Railway Corporation.
 
 
 
• **Karbude Tunnel -** 
 
 
• The Karbude tunnel was India's longest rail tunnel until the Pir Panjal tunnel was constructed.
 
• This is 6.5 Km long and located on the Konkan Railway route near Ratnagiri in Maharashtra.
 
• It is located between Ukshi and Bhoke stations.
